description: Flexible use of property as Class A2 ( Financial and professional services) and Class D1 (Non-clinical therapy)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1, 2 received 01/05/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use of the premises hereby approved shall only be for either, Class A2 uses only, with the exception of the use of the premises as a betting shop, which shall be prohibited, or the D1 (non-clinical therapy) use hereby approved.  

In respect of any of the above hereby approved, notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification; the use shall not be changed to any other Use Class without further approval in writing from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The use of the unit hereby permitted shall not be carried on outside the following times:
9:00am to 8:00pm on Mondays to Fridays
9:00am to 5:00pm on Saturdays
10:00am to 4:00pm on Sundays and Public Holidays

Condition : 5 - The development shall not be occupied until the existing redundant vehicular access to Belmont Road is permanently closed with kerbs, verge, and/or footway reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement, including removal of any footway crossover.
